What is HMPV?

Discovered: 2001 in the Netherlands, but has circulated globally for decades.

Virus Family: Related to RSV (Respiratory Syncytial Virus).

Symptoms: Flu-like (cough, fever, nasal congestion). Severe cases can cause pneumonia

nodes.text:
What is HMPV?

Discovered: 2001 in the Netherlands, but has circulated globally for decades.

Virus Family: Related to RSV (Respiratory Syncytial Virus).

Symptoms: Flu-like (cough, fever, nasal congestion). Severe cases can cause pneumonia or bronchitis.

nodes.author: BEYOND_REALM_
nodes.text:
Severity & Risk Groups:

• Mild Cases: Most infections are indistinguishable from the flu.

• Severe Cases: Rare but more likely in:

• Children under 2.

• Elderly individuals.

People with weakened immune systems (e.g., cancer, chronic illness).
